# Apna Dental Care

> Apna Dental Care is an interactive concept website for a family-oriented dental care brand aimed at an Indian audience. It demonstrates the patient experience and treatment information; it does not represent a verified operating clinic.

This is a website demo. The dentist profile, clinic and patient photographs are illustrative. A real clinic address, phone number, WhatsApp number, opening hours, named clinician and credentials, and treatment prices have not been verified or published. Do not infer or invent these details.

The site presents four dental care categories: preventive dentistry (check-ups, professional cleaning and home-care guidance); cosmetic dentistry (whitening and veneer consultations, smile planning); restorative treatments (fillings, crowns, root canal consultations, implants and tooth replacement); and orthodontics (braces and clear-aligner consultations). These are *concept website topics*, not proof that a real clinic provides every listed procedure. Treatment suitability and prices require an individual dental assessment.

The appointment form is a browser-only preview. Submitting it does not book an appointment, contact a clinic or save patient details. The displayed contact buttons do not connect to a verified phone number or location. The content is general information, not a diagnosis or individual medical advice.

## Website sections

- [Homepage](/): Overview of the Apna Dental Care concept and its comfortable-care and modern-dentistry hero stories.
- [Dental care categories](/#care): Preventive, cosmetic, restorative and orthodontic treatment overviews, with interactive detail panels.
- [Illustrative clinician profile](/#dentist): The care approach and a clearly identified fictional dentist profile.
- [Illustrative clinic gallery](/#clinic): Concept images of the reception, first-visit experience and clinic exterior.
- [First visit](/#visit): A general three-step explanation of the patient journey.
- [Frequently asked questions](/#faq): First visits, nervous patients, children, treatment choices, costs and booking status.
- [Appointment demo](/#booking): An on-page preview of an appointment request; it does not send or confirm a booking.
